trailhead.label: Malga Rolle below the Passo Rolle, the board’s start

cautions: Roots and rocky stretches on the mule track: not for pushchairs, as the board warns.
The start is by the Passo Rolle road: keep your dog on a short lead in the car park.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
